title: Broken provenance
demonstrates: Hash-linked parents make it impossible to cut, swap or rewrite ancestry unnoticed.

variants.title: Delete the parent dataset record
variants.attack: envelope and index row of the training dataset removed
evidence: V5 FAIL: parent 6a1a2e28-830c-4c7c-9ac4-227d1854e333 (trained_on): no signed envelope for 6a1a2e28-830c-4c7c-9ac4-227d1854e333
V8 FAIL: base_model must have a 'dataset' parent

variants.title: Re-sign a modified parent (history rewrite)
variants.attack: dataset changed and re-signed with the legitimate data-steward key
evidence: V5 FAIL: parent digits-train (trained_on) manifest digest changed: expected sha256:b8b50fb8b789..., found sha256:f518da6269a3...

details.note: the re-signed dataset verifies on its own; the hash link from the model exposes the rewrite

variants.title: Edit parent link without re-signing
variants.attack: base model now claims the fine-tune dataset as parent
evidence: V3 FAIL: signature does not match the manifest payload

variants.title: Model with no dataset ancestry
variants.attack: validly signed by training_pipeline, registration policy bypassed
evidence: V8 FAIL: base_model must have a 'dataset' parent
